signal: Alogent's Unify payments platform was shortlisted for Best PayTech Solution at the Banking Tech Awards USA 2026

email.body1:
Don, saw Alogent's Unify got shortlisted for Best PayTech at the Banking Tech Awards USA 2026.

Recognition like that usually pulls more banks and credit unions into the funnel than your team can work before the buzz fades, and that is where deals quietly stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Alogent off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Don, quick follow-up for Alogent.

Most teams selling into banks know the target but not how many meetings it actually takes to get there, so the coverage gap surfaces late and the quarter turns into a scramble. Reps burning hours on research and CRM instead of conversations only widens it.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Alogent needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Don, last bit of proof for Alogent.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Alogent's reply rate likely compares to peer fintech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Don, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Selling payments into regulated FIs has its own long cycles, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a banking sales motion? I'll tailor it to Alogent either way.
